adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a bug in the totalPages calculation. Looking at line 13: `return Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1;` - when user_count is exactly divisible by limit (e.g., 50 users with limit 50), this returns Math.floor(50/50) + 1 = 2 pages, but there should only be 1 page. The correct formula should be Math.ceil(user_count / limit) or handle the exact division case. This would cause an empty page to appear when navigating.
